title: Captain Hollanda Lima's encounter with a being in a space suit

tellings.quote: He himself actually saw an alien being that was in a space suit and and the the being sort of gave him a hug

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of Captain Uyrangê Hollanda Lima, a Brazilian military officer tied to Operation Prato, a Brazilian military investigation of strange sightings around the town of Colares in the state of Pará in the late 1970s. Michels says the captain himself saw an alien being in a space suit, and that the being gave him a hug. If true, it would mean an officer leading an official inquiry had close, personal contact with a non-human being.
